title: Urashima Tarō and the Sea Palace

game.start: Help Tarō clear the beach! Tap each driftwood stick so the turtle can reach the sea.
game.praise: The path is clear! Swim home, little friend!

game.start: Something is bubbling around the boat! Tap the three bubble rings to see who is calling.
game.praise: Hello again! It is the sea turtle!

game.start: Ride the turtle down the Sea Road! Tap the glowing spot to steer past the coral reefs.
game.praise: Way to steer! Look at the golden glow ahead!

game.start: Welcome Tarō to the Sea Palace! Tap each pearl lantern by the gate to make it shine.
game.praise: Every pearl lantern is glowing! Welcome to the palace!

game.start: The sea band is playing! Listen to the drums and shell chime, then tap the song back.
game.praise: Pon, pon, chime! What a wonderful sea song!

game.start: Help Princess Otohime tie the red silk cord! Tap when the ring turns green to tie each knot tight.
game.praise: Three tight knots! Remember the promise: never open the box.

game.start: The deep water is dim! Tap the five lantern-jellyfish to light the road back up to the sun.
game.praise: So bright! Up into the sunshine we go!

game.start: Everything looks different! Tap the tall pine tree, the new cottage, and the old fisherman to look for Tarō's home.
game.praise: Three hundred years have passed while Tarō was under the sea!

game.start: White mist fills the shore! Tap the three soft cloud puffs to gently clear the air.
game.praise: The mist has cleared! Look at Grandfather Tarō's snowy white beard!

game.start: Share warm rice cakes under the pine tree! Tap each rice cake, then tap who it is for.
game.praise: Warm cakes and kind friends! Everyone is smiling by the sea.
